task.body: Add a property test in `test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs` verifying that `Tau.Settings.Loader` merge is commutative for non-conflicting keys and right-biased for conflicts, then make `mix test` pass.

implementer.diff:
diff --git a/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs b/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
index 545db4d..9a19965 100644
--- a/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
+++ b/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 defmodule Tau.Settings.LoaderTest do
   use ExUnit.Case, async: true
+  use ExUnitProperties
 
   alias Tau.Settings.Loader
 
@@ -31,4 +32,43 @@ defmodule Tau.Settings.LoaderTest do
       assert merged[:permissions][:deny] == ["Bash(rm *)", "Bash(sudo *)"]
     end
   end
+
+  # Fixed key alphabet keeps generated maps realistic and avoids atom exhaustion.
+  @key_pool [:alpha, :beta, :gamma, :delta, :epsilon, :zeta, :eta, :theta]
+
+  defp scalar_gen do
+    one_of([integer(), string(:alphanumeric)])
+  end
+
+  defp key_gen, do: member_of(@key_pool)
+
+  describe "merge/2 properties" do
+    @tag :property
+    property "commutative for non-conflicting keys" do
+      # Split the key pool so the two halves never share a key — that guarantees
+      # merge(a, b) and merge(b, a) see no conflicts and must yield the same map.
+      {pool_a, pool_b} = Enum.split(@key_pool, div(length(@key_pool), 2))
+
+      check all a <- map_of(member_of(pool_a), scalar_gen(), max_length: 3),
+                b <- map_of(member_of(pool_b), scalar_gen(), max_length: 3) do
+        assert Loader.merge(a, b) == Loader.merge(b, a)
+      end
+    end
+
+    @tag :property
+    property "right-biased for conflicting scalar keys" do
+      check all keys <- list_of(key_gen(), min_length: 1, max_length: 4),
+                keys = Enum.uniq(keys),
+                vals_a <- list_of(scalar_gen(), length: length(keys)),
+                vals_b <- list_of(scalar_gen(), length: length(keys)) do
+        a = Map.new(Enum.zip(keys, vals_a))
+        b = Map.new(Enum.zip(keys, vals_b))
+        merged = Loader.merge(a, b)
+
+        Enum.each(keys, fn k ->
+          assert Map.fetch!(merged, k) == Map.fetch!(b, k)
+        end)
+      end
+    end
+  end
 end
implementer.stdout_excerpt:
All 6 tests pass (4 existing + 2 new properties). The final test file adds:

- **`commutative for non-conflicting keys`** — splits the 8-key pool into two disjoint halves, generates maps from each half, asserts `merge(a, b) == merge(b, a)`.
- **`right-biased for conflicting scalar keys`** — generates two maps with identical key sets, asserts every conflicting key resolves to the value from the right-hand map.
